name: N Candles
summary: This EA analyzes N consecutive candles to identify trading patterns and generate entry signals. It likely looks for sequences of consecutive bullish or bearish candles to determine trend continuation or reversal opportunities. The EA opens positions based on the candle sequence pattern detection results.
summary_zh: 该EA通过分析N根连续K线的形态来识别交易模式并生成入场信号。它可能查找连续阳线或阴线的序列来判断趋势延续或反转机会，并根据K线序列模式检测结果开仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是检测N根连续K线的方向一致性，当出现连续同向K线时视为趋势信号入场。入场条件为连续N根阳线做多、连续N根阴线做空，属于简单的K线形态识别策略。出场条件可能基于固定止盈止损或反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理方面从参数名推测使用固定手数，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面没有明显的风险控制逻辑，仅依赖固定止损。该策略属于最基础的K线形态策略，逻辑简单但缺乏过滤条件容易产生虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy detects directional consistency across N consecutive candles, treating consecutive same-direction candles as trend signals for entry. Entry conditions are buying after N consecutive bullish candles and selling after N consecutive bearish candles, representing a simple candlestick pattern recognition approach. Exit conditions likely rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or closing on opposite signal appearance. Position sizing appears to use fixed lot sizes based on parameter naming conventions, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management lacks sophisticated risk control logic, relying solely on fixed stop-loss. This is a basic candlestick pattern strategy with simple logic but vulnerable to false signals due to insufficient filtering conditions.
pros: 逻辑简单直观易于理解
K线形态是最基础的技术分析方法有理论基础
参数少易于优化和回测
pros_en: Simple and intuitive logic easy to understand
Candlestick patterns are fundamental technical analysis with theoretical basis
Few parameters make optimization and backtesting straightforward
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤器在震荡市中频繁亏损
连续K线策略容易受市场噪音干扰产生虚假信号
没有动态仓位管理和资金管理机制
缺少新K线检测可能导致同一信号重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks trend filter causing frequent losses in ranging markets
Consecutive candle strategy vulnerable to market noise producing false signals
No dynamic position sizing or money management mechanism
Missing new bar detection may cause duplicate entries on same signal
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器如均线方向判断避免逆势交易
加入新K线检测确保每个信号只开一次仓
增加ATR动态止损止盈适应市场波动性
加入震荡指标过滤避免在盘整期入场
improvements_en: Add trend filter like MA direction to avoid counter-trend trades
Implement new bar detection to ensure one entry per signal
Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to market volatility
Add oscillator filter to avoid entries during consolidation periods

risk_points: 缺少趋势过滤器在震荡市可能连续亏损
固定止损可能不适合所有市场条件
可能缺少新K线检测导致重复开仓
risk_points_en: Missing trend filter may cause consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss may not suit all market conditions
May lack new bar detection leading to duplicate position opening
